channel.title: iNoon Windows Official Updates
channel.description: Secure software updates for iNoon on Windows.

item.title: iNoon 1.0.0 for Windows
item.description: - Improved folder sync for iPhone and iPad. - Better AI language handling and translated provider feedback. - Updated usage statistics and privacy controls, plus reliability fixes.

item.title: iNoon 1.0.0 for Windows
item.description: - Sync PC folders with compatible iPhone and iPad app folders: add-and-update, one-way mirror or two-way sync over USB or Wi-Fi. Keep iNoon open for automatic sync; mirror mode deletes extra destination files. - AI replies now follow the app language, with clearer translated provider feedback. - Bug fixes and reliability improvements.

item.title: iNoon 1.0.0 for Windows
item.description: - Attach images, PDFs, and text files to Agent conversations. - More reliable Agent providers and model selection. - Clearer backup and update progress, plus interface fixes.
